title: Coursera Course Analysis — Licensed Import or Synthetic Demo
description: Compare authorized course observations or view invented US learning reports. No live Coursera/Udemy collection, API, login, proxy, history refresh or enrollment.

mode.title: Data mode
enumTitles: Synthetic preview — NOT real course data
mode.description: Choose explicitly. Old search/proxy tasks receive a migration error. Demos create zero dataset rows/result fees, but start and platform usage apply.

demoPreset.title: Synthetic US learning preview
demoPreset.description: Invented developer examples, not Coursera prices, course recommendations or real change history.

importJson.title: Licensed observations — JSON text
importJson.description: Paste an ARRAY as text, maximum 2 MiB / 1,000 observations / 60 fields per row. Required: courseId string, title, observedAt UTC date/timestamp. No URL/file fetching. Never include learner data, credentials or assessment content.

importCsv.title: Licensed observations — CSV text
importCsv.description: Header plus 1–1,000 rows, maximum 2 MiB / 60 columns. Skills use | separators or a JSON list. Prices and hours must be unambiguous numeric values. See README context guide.

importSource.title: Export provider/source label
importSource.description: Required for import, maximum 160 characters. Public report label; never put credentials or personal data here. It does not establish source rights or accuracy.

authorizedData.title: I am licensed to use this export through this paid analysis service
authorizedData.description: TRUE required for import. Public visibility, ordinary learner/API access, or another scraper does not by itself establish commercial rights. Declaration is not a verified licence; demo does not require it.

maxResults.title: Maximum saved course analyses
maxResults.description: Import: first-seen unique course IDs, including all their supplied observations. Whole-course cap; omitted courses are not billed/exported. Demos have up to three invented previews, not dataset rows.

requiredSkills.title: Required skill tags
requiredSkills.description: Up to 50 tags / 80 characters. Exact case/whitespace/Unicode-normalized matching only. No semantic equivalence, skill proficiency or employability inference.

targetDifficulties.title: Target supplied difficulty
targetDifficulties.description: Optional review criterion; missing difficulty remains unknown.

budgetUsd.title: Entered per-learner learning budget — USD
budgetUsd.description: Optional. Evaluated only for complete US/USD standard quotes with explicit billing, price-scope, tax basis and additional fees. Not a live price or team-license estimate.

maximumStudyHours.title: Maximum supplied study hours
maximumStudyHours.description: Optional; duration labels/month buckets are never converted into hours. Not a completion-time prediction.

subscriptionPeriods.title: Assumed subscription periods
subscriptionPeriods.description: Multiply complete subscription quotes by this entered scenario. Monthly/annual contexts stay separate; no completion/certificate guarantee. No per-course sum of catalog subscriptions.

priceChangeThresholdPercent.title: Quoted price change threshold — %
priceChangeThresholdPercent.description: Latest two matching supplied standard offer observations only. Zero/unknown baselines, mismatched contexts or excessive gaps do not yield numerical alerts.

comparisonWindowDays.title: Maximum supplied comparison gap — days
comparisonWindowDays.description: Reports the latest pair in each context; not cross-run state, source refresh, monitoring service or notifications.
